title: Materials
subtitle: Texts and files that lessons are built from.

uploader.title: Add a material

mode.legend: How do you want to add the material?

file.dropHint: Drag a file here or choose it below.
file.formats: TXT, MD or PDF, up to {{size}}. DOCX is not supported. A scanned PDF is recognised on the server, which takes longer than a file with a text layer.

titleField.label: Title
titleField.hint: Optional: the file name is used when left empty.

uploader.success: “{{title}}” has been added and is ready for lessons.
uploader.accepted: “{{title}}” has been accepted and is being processed: the text is read page by page, and for a scan that can take several minutes. You do not have to wait here — the progress is shown in the list of materials below.

validation.unsupportedFormat: Only TXT, MD and PDF files are supported. DOCX is not.
validation.tooLarge: The file is larger than {{size}}. Upload a smaller file or split it into parts.
validation.empty: The file is empty: there is nothing to extract.
validation.noText: Paste the text of the material.
validation.textTooLong: The text is longer than {{max}} characters. Shorten it or split it into several materials.

list.title: Your materials
list.empty: No materials yet. Upload a file or paste a text above.
list.error: The list of materials could not be loaded.

pending.label: Queued
pending.hint: The material is waiting for its text to be extracted.

processing.label: Processing
processing.hint: The text is being extracted right now; the fragment count will appear shortly.

ready.label: Ready
ready.hint: The text has been extracted, the material can be used in lessons.

error_no_text_layer.label: PDF without a text layer
error_no_text_layer.hint: The pages of this PDF are images (a scan), and no text could be obtained from them. Upload a PDF whose text can be selected, or paste the text by hand.

error_unsupported_format.label: Unsupported format
error_unsupported_format.hint: Text can only be extracted from TXT, MD and PDF files. Convert the document or paste its text by hand.

error_too_large.label: Too large
error_too_large.hint: The file is bigger than the server accepts. Split it into parts and upload them one by one.

error_extraction_failed.label: Extraction failed
error_extraction_failed.hint: The file could not be read to the end: it may be damaged or protected. Re-save it or paste the text by hand.

status.notReadyForLesson: The material can be picked for a lesson once the processing is over.

delete.title: Confirm deletion
delete.question: Delete “{{title}}”?
delete.warning: The material and its fragments will be removed; lessons already built from it stay as they are.

preview.title: Material text
preview.nothingSelected: Choose a material in the list to see its text.
preview.error: The material could not be opened.
preview.noText: No text has been extracted from this material.

errors.tooLarge: The server rejected the file: it exceeds the limit of {{size}}. Upload a smaller file or split it into parts.
errors.unsupportedFormat: The server rejected the file format. Upload TXT, MD or PDF.
errors.rejected: The server rejected the material: check the title, the text and the file.
errors.deleteFailed: The material could not be deleted.
